comments.author: @thakanemakume8463
comments.text: A good documentary, but it needs a lot of editing. There is too much Eastern/Western Africa added to this. Also please correct the pronunciation of the country, we don't pronounce it like that. About 80% of this documentary is not true for Lesotho. May I also take this opportunity and invite you to visit the Kingdom of Lesotho, you will find a different country altogether from this documentary. Lesotho haeso....!
